title: Context compaction mid-run forced use of external Read tool for file content recovery
description: Run 2aa600af-d3ac-46fa-9202-0780b1da8194 experienced context compaction after Phase 2. Upon resumption, the three skill file contents were no longer in context, requiring external Read tool calls (native Claude Code) instead of moeb read_file. This produced a moeb-tool-origin rubric failure even though the moeb equivalent exists.
proposed_resolution: Document in skill guidance that read_file (moeb) must be called to re-read files after context compaction rather than the native Read tool. Consider run-state checkpointing of critical file hashes to detect when re-reads are needed.
